title: 青葉賞の後に・過ぎる影は

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite her magnificent showing at the Aoba Sho, Mejiro Ardan feels an indescribable uneasiness akin to anxiety deep down inside…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The following day, Mejiro Ardan realizes that Sakura Chiyono O and Yaeno Muteki will make for formidable foes at the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Furthermore, she now understands that the source of her anxiety lies with their recent rise to the top.
